sections.heading: Principle
sections.body: Name what the relationship is FOR, not a list of contacts. A bond type is only real when several signatures point to it; one aspect is not a bond. Most real relationships are a blend of two or three types.

sections.heading: Bond Types
sections.body: A bond type needs multiple signatures. Most relationships blend two or three types.

items.label: The Spark (chemistry)
items.body: Core signatures: Venus-Mars, Mars-Mars, Sun-Mars contacts; 5th-house overlays. What it is for: passion, attraction, feeling alive. The work: Chemistry is not compatibility. Enjoy it for what it is, or build something underneath it; heat alone says nothing about whether you can live together.

items.label: The Build (partnership)
items.body: Core signatures: supportive Saturn-Sun/Venus, Sun-Moon, 7th-house overlays. What it is for: lasting commitment and structure. The work: Durability over excitement. Keep warmth inside the structure so commitment doesn't curdle into duty.

items.label: The Mirror (recognition)
items.body: Core signatures: Sun-Moon, Moon-Moon, Sun-Ascendant, strong luminary overlays. What it is for: feeling deeply seen and at home. The work: Being recognized isn't the same as a workable relationship. Don't mistake familiarity for ease.

items.label: The Crucible (intense / transformative)
items.body: Core signatures: Pluto contacts (Pluto-Venus/Moon/Sun), 8th-house overlays. What it is for: depth, transformation, being changed by each other. The work: Intensity is not compatibility. The depth is real and high-stakes; watch for control, and let it transform you without dominating you.

items.label: The Fated (karmic)
items.body: Core signatures: Saturn, South Node, Vertex, and nodal contacts. What it is for: a sense of fated-feeling significance, recognition, unfinished business. The work: 'Fated' is a feeling, not a contract. Honor the pull; remember you still choose whether to stay.

items.label: The Teacher (growth)
items.body: Core signatures: Jupiter and Saturn contacts, 9th-house overlays, node links. What it is for: growth, expansion, maturing one another. The work: Peers, not pedestals. The lesson goes both ways or it becomes a power gap.

items.label: The Ease (friendship)
items.body: Core signatures: harmonious Mercury and Venus contacts, 11th-house overlays, shared air. What it is for: companionship and easy liking. The work: Ease can lack heat. Fine if that's what you both want; honest if it isn't.

items.label: The Grind (friction)
items.body: Core signatures: squares and oppositions, Mars-Saturn, Mercury-Mars. What it is for: challenge and growth through abrasion. The work: Friction can be generative or corrosive; the difference is mutual respect. If it's all wear and no spark, name it.

sections.heading: Attachment Lens
sections.body: A supplementary psychological lens, framed as analogues, not clinical diagnosis. Read the Moon, Venus, and Saturn contacts as the bond's attachment tone.

items.label: secure_analogue
items.body: harmonious Moon and Venus contacts; Saturn offering steady support rather than restriction. The bond feels safe and consistent.

items.label: anxious_analogue
items.body: Moon-Pluto, Moon-Mars, Venus-Saturn hard contacts. Craving closeness while fearing loss; push-pull and testing.

items.label: avoidant_analogue
items.body: Moon-Uranus, hard Moon-Saturn, distancing Saturn. Needing space, pulling back when things get close, discomfort with dependence.

sections.heading: Ethics
sections.body: Synastry describes the pull, not the outcome. A bond type needs multiple indicators, never one aspect. Intensity isn't compatibility; fated is a feeling, not a contract; never romanticize control or coercion. Every type carries its work, so the reading stays agency-forward.

sections.heading: Examples
sections.body: Use these as synthesis patterns, not verdicts.

items.label: Example 1
items.body: Most bonds blend: Venus-Mars (spark) plus supportive Saturn-Sun (build) is a chemistry-and-commitment bond, the rarer combination that's both exciting and durable. Read both, not one.

items.label: Example 2
items.body: A Pluto-heavy, 8th-house-overlay bond is the Crucible type: it will change both people. That is not the same as easy or good. The work is keeping depth from turning into control.

items.label: Example 3
items.body: South Node plus Saturn contacts make a Fated bond: it feels like you've met before and can't quite leave. Honor the feeling, remember it's a feeling, and choose on purpose.

sections.heading: Integration
sections.body: Reads from synastry_aspects (and the marquee), synastry_house_overlays, synastry_features, and the composite work; the synthesisExamples in composite_chart_marquee show how to layer the composite on top.
